findings.label: Synchronous email sending latency risk
findings.description: Email delivery is synchronous and blocks the API response. If the mail provider is slow or unreachable, the user creation endpoint will time out. Low likelihood in practice for healthy mail services, but a known trade-off worth monitoring.

findings.label: Resend HTTP API dependency
findings.description: Current production configuration uses Resend instead of SMTP to bypass Render port restrictions. Resend is a single point of failure; if Resend API is down, all password emails fail. No fallback to SMTP is in place.

findings.label: Email not sent if password property is not exposed
findings.description: A subtle risk during future refactoring: if the Mailable's temporaryPassword property is renamed or the with() call is removed, the template will render empty password fields silently. No compile-time check exists to catch this.

findings.label: Frontend doesn't show the generated password if email succeeds
findings.description: When email is sent successfully, the admin sees only a confirmation message. If the admin needs to manually notify the user (e.g., user lost the email), the password is not available in the UI. A copyable password field would improve fallback notification.
